hltv_first.finding: Exact fixture confirmed: Zetta (HLTV team 13833, HLTV rank #241 shown) vs LOS NINOS (team 14092), Best of 3 (Online), Swiss round 5, starting ~2h32m after observation. kalshi.finding: IRREGULARITY: this market is 'Los Ninos vs Alianza Lima Esports' (ticker ...LNALE), not Zetta vs LOS NINOS. Alianza Lima Esports is a distinct CCT SA S7 participant (played Damajuana on 14 Oct and SUKEBAN on 15 Oct), not a verified alias of Zetta. Prices at observation (LN Yes 66c / No 45c) describe a different named opponent.

polymarket.finding: Polymarket's CCT South America list at observation had exactly two events: Damajuana vs Hacha Esports and 'Alianza Lima Esports vs Los Ninos (BO3)' (cs2-ale1-ln-2026-10-21, 6:00 PM ET). No Zetta vs LOS NINOS market was listed. Polymarket names HLTV as its resolution source, and HLTV lists Zetta as the opponent, so the prediction-market opponent name is unverified against HLTV.

method_notes: Order followed the request: HLTV first for fixture identity/format/rankings, then esportsbooks/prediction markets for two-sided prices.
Hotspawn participation percentages and HLTV fan votes were recorded only to document that they were NOT used.
In-play prices (Damajuana vs Hacha after start) are never relabelled as prematch lines.
A market must match BOTH team names and the start time; a one-team/time match (Kalshi LN vs ALE) is not a valid join.

Sandbox direct network access to HLTV/Hotspawn/Polymarket APIs is blocked; pages were read through the research fetcher and GitHub's official run annotations. Original API payloads therefore could not be hashed in this session - a stated limitation, not a silent gap.
